params.body:
The repository had no README. This one says what the repo itself says: the site and what it carries (framework, services, tools, in the site's own words), the stack (Hugo 0.155.2 from netlify.toml, the custom theme, two languages with the texts in i18n/, the framework as data in data/pac.json published as /framework/pac.json), the layout, how to build it, what the one workflow checks, how Netlify deploys it, and that Elixir measures production.

Two things the repo made me leave out or say carefully: the framework page says "18 questions" while data/pac.json carries 19 ids, so the README says "a set of questions"; and static/js/pac-mapper.es.js and layouts/_default/consultancy.html are shipped but referenced by nothing.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: README: what the repo says about itself
